'''Kel-Fi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living in [[Voss-Ka]] on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he asked an outsider about the factions of the larger [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and what they meant for the Voss.
